observations.architecture: The first complete run reached three captures before the final upper-window pixels overlapped the information card. The resumed four-view run was independently checked for the twelve sample points and thirty ground probes.
observations.mouse: The real mouse selection precedes an exit 1 during loading. The independent successful renderer reopened the selected URL. The host receipt retains both Chromium identifiers and the SHA-256 of the first selection record.
observations.touch: A trusted touch selected the same feature and produced the phone image in one actual browser.
observations.guest: Native and viewer were admitted from separate physical host stages. Each dispatch revision survives with its corresponding receipt and original program signature.
observations.distant: The same browser drew both registered assets. At zoom 15.65 it was still near, then zoom 15.18371 reached the distant geometry at 1053.93 m. Six background material, macro or nearby-building warnings are preserved. After the image and downloads, the browser first received Browser.close, then SIGTERM; the supervisor found no remaining children.
observations.ordinary: The first Playwright cold start did not produce a frame. A second run caught a difference between the live workspace shared module and the frozen city version. The two final independent Chromium sessions 722307 and 722614 used the frozen page, with a 1250×820/390×844 CSS viewport and native compositor rasters of 313×205/98×211.
